full_judgment: 13. The trial Court had clearly opined from a perusal of the appellant's purchase documents that the building of the plaintiff's father was the eastern boundary of the plaintiffs land. The trial Court also found that the appellant had gathered immense house building materials on his plot of land and that the balance of inconveniences are heavily in his favour. The High Court Division does not appear to have adverted to these findings at all. Consequently, the reversal of the two Courts' judgment in revision are without any legal foundation.
